title: [MTR4] LHB VTA (+AKN Assets)
description: This project adds the VTA DMUs built by LHB in the AKN livery as well as assets for a AKN network
body:
This project adds the VTA DMUs built by LHB in the AKN livery as well as assets for a AKN network

_Adds:_

**-LHB VTA (AKN Livery)**

**-AKN station cube**

**-AKN pids decoration (best used with joban client mod display and teampommes' world pids pack)**


This pack is not an official product of AKN Eisenbahn GmbH.

Big shoutout and thank you to NickDash for making the asset models and to Dragon his diesel sounds.
